name: Hajdúdorog (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Hajdúdorog (a red shield with a white arm holding a sabre, with a helm, a patriarchal cross crest, flags and red and blue mantling) above the name HAJDÚDOROG in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Hajdúdorog arms with helm, crest and mantling
